title: mvschwarz/openrig
headline: OpenRig builds persistent agent teams from Claude Code and Codex
lede: You can wire Claude Code, Codex and Pi into persistent teams with roles, shared context and owned work.

effects.effect: Multi-vendor agent teams become easier to assemble
Role-based agent workflows for software tasks

possibilities.title: Agencies can bill each persistent agent role to the right client AWS account

with.title: Claude Code adds cross-account AWS roles and mod effort

possibilities.connection: OpenRig wires Claude Code into persistent teams with owned work, and Claude Code can now assume a role in another AWS account and run forked side jobs at low effort, so each role's spend lands in a client's account at a controlled cost.

possibilities.title: Self-hosted Git servers become the hidden bottleneck for persistent agent teams

with.title: OpenAI's Pando, a Git-compatible backend for Codex scale

possibilities.connection: OpenRig wires Claude Code, Codex and Pi into persistent teams with owned work, and OpenAI's Pando account shows agent development volume forced a rebuild of a Git backend.
